race.comment: SUPER SENTAI (4) has the most appealing profile after working home from a long way back for third at this track last start, and that effort has more substance now he drops in weight and gets Chris Parnham back aboard. Back out to 1400m now doesn't look an issue and he can put it all together today. RISING FAME (11) is the danger after a brave third at Ascot, beaten just over a length, following a decisive York win as favourite. The one-week turnaround is the small reservation, but her recent form reads well. RUN PATTIE RUN (6) has been close up at her past two, beaten a length and a half at Northam and just under two lengths at Ascot, so she is better placed than the form figures suggest. BARRON BILL (3) disappointed first-up as favourite, yet his previous Open win at this venue keeps him in the mix if he handles 1400m for the first time. QUEEN ARIA (2) can improve third-up.
